Oxford SuperNova Dual diffractometer with Cu at zero and Atlas detector

Method = Modified Sheldrick
w = 1/[\s^2^(F^2^) + (0.12P)^2^ + 0.13P], where P = [max(Fo^2^,0) + 2Fc^2^]/3
Oxford SuperNova Dual diffractometer with Cu at zero and Atlas detector

Method = Modified Sheldrick
w = 1/[\s^2^(F^2^) + (0.09P)^2^ + 1.26P], where P = [max(Fo^2^,0) + 2Fc^2^]/3

The crystal was initially placed in the cold stream of an Oxford Cryosystems
open-flow nitrogen cryostat (Cosier & Glazer, 1986) at 100 K with a nominal
stability of 0.1 K. On completion, the crystal was warmed to 300 K at
120 K h^-1^, where it remained for approximately 30 min. It was then cooled to
250 K (120 K h^-1^), where a second data collection was recorded, before
cooling to 100 K (120 K h^-1^) for a third data collection.
